newsitem.title: UK: ICI stake in India's Asian Paints.
newsitem.headline: ICI stake in India's Asian Paints.

text.p: British chemicals and paints group ICI Plc said on Monday it had purchased a 9.1 percent stake in one of India's largest paints company Asian Paints(India) Ltd for 23 million stg.
ICI said it had agreed to purchase 3.67 million shares at a price of 351 rupees per share.
The shares have been bought through brokers Kotak Mahindra Capital Company.
Asian Paints' share price closed at 311.75 rupees on Friday, indicating a 13 percent premium paid by ICI.
Asian Paints is controlled by the Choksey family which last week made a last minute cancellation of a sale deal for 3.5 million shares in the company.
ICI did not say whether brokers Kotak Mahindra were acting on behalf of the Choksey family.
The transaction is, however, subject to regulatory approvals in India. --Arindam Nag, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
